GioLina · Sweet Sixteen

A celebration.
A signature all your own.

Sweet Sixteen photography & cinematography,
with a little more care behind the camera.

Let’s plan your celebration

A boutique approach

Big-night energy.
Beautifully considered.

The production care we bring to weddings belongs here, too. We get to know the family, listen to what makes this celebration yours, and prepare so you can enjoy it.

From portraits before the party to the entrance, speeches and dance floor, we work attentively around you. The people and personality of the night stay at the center.

Tell us what you have in mind →

Photography & cinema

Two ways to keep the night.

People. Details. The whole room.

Portraits with presence, candid photographs with character, and the details that made the celebration feel like you.

Let the celebration move.

The voices, music and movement of the evening, shaped into a personal film you can return to together.

Gianna

Gabby

Julianna

Ask about photography & cinema →

Before, during & after

Prepared for the party.
Present for the people.

  1. Start with a conversation.

    Share the date, venue, plans and personalities. We’ll discuss the schedule, important people, photography and film priorities before the celebration.

  2. Enjoy the night.

    We arrive with a plan, make room for portraits, and anticipate the entrances, traditions and surprises that matter to your family.

  3. Keep something personal.

    After the event, we bring the photographs and footage together with care. Your proposal will explain the final photo and film selections for your coverage.

A few things to know

Your celebration,
your questions.

Can we discuss photography and cinematography together?

Yes. Tell us what you’d like to keep from the celebration, and we can discuss photography, cinematography or both.

How do we prepare before the event?

We talk through your plans, venue, schedule and family priorities. Share important entrances, speeches and traditions so we can plan around them.

Can portraits be part of the coverage?

We can discuss portraits alongside candid coverage and make time for them in your event plan. The details belong in your custom proposal.

What coverage and final films or photos are included?

Coverage is discussed around your celebration. Your proposal will set out the agreed coverage and final photo and film work; contact us to talk through the options.

What does Sweet Sixteen coverage cost?

Tell us the date, location and what you have planned. We’ll discuss the coverage and prepare a proposal for your celebration.

How do we start?

Send an inquiry with your event date and plans, or schedule a conversation.

Make it yours
